course.title: Unit 3 My School【例句】
course.description: SECTION B What fun things do you do at school?

sentences.content: To answer your question, my new school is great!
sentences.english: To answer your question , my new school is great !
sentences.chinese: 回答你的问题，我的新学校很棒！

sentences.content: There's a large sports field next to the teachers' building.
sentences.english: There's a large sports field next to the teachers' building
sentences.chinese: 教师大楼旁边有一个大型运动场。

sentences.content: All the students go there and do exercises together in the morning.
sentences.english: All the students go there and do exercises together in the morning
sentences.chinese: 所有学生早上都会去那里一起做运动。

sentences.content: Every Monday we raise the flag there.
sentences.english: Every Monday we raise the flag there
sentences.chinese: 每周一我们都在那里升旗。

sentences.content: It's a special way to start the week.
sentences.english: It's a special way to start the week
sentences.chinese: 这是开启一周的特别方式。

sentences.content: The classroom building is behind the sports field.
sentences.english: The classroom building is behind the sports field
sentences.chinese: 教学楼位于运动场后方。

wordDetails.definition: be（第三人称单数现在时）: 是

sentences.content: We spend most of the time in our classroom.
sentences.english: We spend most of the time in our classroom
sentences.chinese: 我们大部分时间都在教室里度过。

sentences.content: This week I sit next to my best friend, Han Lin.
sentences.english: This week I sit next to my best friend , Han Lin
sentences.chinese: 这周我坐在我最好的朋友Han Lin旁边。

sentences.content: The dining hall is across from the sports field.
sentences.english: The dining hall is across from the sports field

sentences.content: It's my favourite place because there are many kinds of food.
sentences.english: It's my favourite place because there are many kinds of food
sentences.chinese: 这是我最喜欢的地方，因为这里有各式各样的美食。

sentences.content: I love the Chinese food there.
sentences.english: I love the Chinese food there

sentences.chinese: 他们包的饺子非常美味。
